requirements.description: Proponents will be evaluated only on the service category(ies) for which they submit a response.
Page size must be 8½ x 11 inches, with standard margins and a minimum font size of 10 points.
Responses must not exceed twelve (12) pages, excluding resumes or professional profiles, and work or product samples requested herein.

Proponents must describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup, including profile and history of the organisation; number of employees; a list and description of the products and services offered in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of experience with each, and identify core areas of expertise or specialty; and a list of any requirements that fall outside the firm's scope.

Proponents must demonstrate capabilities and capacity to provide required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. Response must include brief profiles (no more than half a page each) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank, including name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.

Proponents must describe the practitioner talent their firm can draw on, internally or externally, including the range of expertise available, how practitioners are vetted and developed, how quality and consistency are ensured when engaging associates or contractors, and what a typical resource assignment process looks like.

Proponents must describe their approach to delivering HR advisory services and managing consulting engagements, including the methodology used to assess organizational needs and define desired outcomes; approach to developing recommendations and implementation plans; governance model and project management approach; stakeholder engagement and consultation methodologies; change management and communication approaches, where applicable; and quality assurance processes.

Proponents must demonstrate ability to provide strategic insights, innovative solutions, and leading practices, including examples of innovative solutions or approaches implemented for clients; experience applying research, data analytics, benchmarking, or emerging HR practices to address client challenges; methods used to remain current with HR trends and industry developments; examples of recommendations that resulted in meaningful organizational improvements; and two (2) samples of published articles, white papers, research, frameworks, or thought leadership materials developed by the Proponent (maximum limit of 2 pages per sample).

Proponents must describe their approach to establishing, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships throughout the term of the Contract, including account management structure and governance processes; key client-facing roles and responsibilities; communication and reporting practices; approach to managing client expectations and competing priorities; escalation and issue-resolution procedures; methods used to monitor client satisfaction and obtain feedback; and an example of how the Proponent successfully responded to changing client requirements or resolved a significant client issue.

Proponents must describe any additional, value-added services, tools, resources, or capabilities that would enhance the Bank's ability to achieve its HR objectives. For each value-added service, proponents must explain the benefit to the Bank, how it supports HR advisory objectives, and any conditions or limitations.

Proponents must demonstrate experience providing strategic HR advisory services to organizations of similar size, complexity, and operating environment. Proponents must provide details for two (2) engagements completed within the last two (2) years, including client organization (or anonymized description if confidentiality applies); organizational size and sector; HR challenge or objective; scope of services provided; key deliverables; stakeholders involved; duration of the engagement; outcomes achieved and benefits realized; and client reference, including contact name, title, email address, and telephone number.

Responses must not exceed twelve (12) pages (excluding resumes or professional profiles, and work or product samples requested herein). Page size must be 8½ x 11 inches, with standard margins and a minimum font size of 10 points.

Proponents are to respond to each of the following requirements in the order presented below. Unless otherwise stated, links to websites or other information external to the form will not be evaluated.
